long_biography.plain_text:
Running América Latina Logística gave Behring direct operating experience before his 3G investment career. As chief executive, he led the freight-rail group for seven years, adding the perspective of a network operator to his private-equity training. He later applied that combination through board roles rather than daily management of portfolio companies.

At 3G, Behring helped lead the Burger King acquisition and creation of Restaurant Brands International. The firm's current interests include Restaurant Brands and Hunter Douglas, while the completed Skechers acquisition extended the portfolio into footwear. Those investments sit within 3G and related corporate structures, with Behring acting as founding partner, co-managing partner and portfolio-company director.
